For You

To You, On Your Birthday

Dear Shara,

Happy birthday, Shara. I honestly don't know how to write this without feeling a lot of things at once. I still love you, and I think a part of me always will. No matter how things ended between us, I could never regret loving you or having you in my life. You've been such a big part of my life, and you've given me so many memories that I'll always carry with me. The laughs, the little moments, the stupid things only we would find funny, and even the hard times. All of it meant something to me because it was with you. But lately, I've been thinking a lot about you and about everything we've been through. I know I've caused you pain, and that's something I'll always be sorry for. I know there were times when I didn't understand you the way I should have, and I know there were moments when I made you feel things you never deserved to feel. I want you to know that your feelings were always valid. Even when I didn't understand them, even when I saw things differently, that never meant you were wrong for feeling the way you did. You had every right to feel hurt, angry, sad, confused, or anything else you felt. I wish I had understood that better while we were together instead of trying to explain myself or make you see things from my side. You deserved to feel heard and understood. The last thing I ever wanted was to be someone who made you hurt, especially when all I've ever wanted was to see you happy. So maybe loving you now means learning how to let you go. I don't want to keep bothering you or keep finding reasons to stay when maybe what you really need is space to breathe, heal, and find yourself again. As much as it hurts me to accept that, I want to respect that. You deserve to be happy. You deserve peace. You deserve to heal from everything that hurt you, even if some of that pain came from me. I won't pretend that letting you go means I stopped loving you. It doesn't. I still have so much love for you in my heart, and honestly, you're still the person I think about when I imagine the kind of person I want to love. But I don't want my love to become something that holds you back. I just hope that someday, when you look back at us, you remember that there was someone who loved you deeply, even if she didn't always know how to love you the right way. For your birthday, I don't want to ask for anything from you. I just want to wish you a genuinely happy life, even if I'm no longer a part of it. I hope this year is kinder to you. I hope you heal from the things that hurt you. I hope you laugh more, find peace, meet good people, and have moments where you realize that you're going to be okay. Thank you for everything, Shara. Thank you for loving me, for staying with me through everything, and for being someone I'll always be grateful to have known. Happy birthday, my love. I hope you're happy. I really do. Take care of yourself, always.

— SC ♡

Happy Birthday, Shara ♡

Thank you for being one of the most beautiful parts of my life.
